$comment: Named presets for the 12 Const + Pick columns of Format A (spec section 3).
These are constant across every run in the testing sandbox, so the UI keeps them
behind an 'advanced' disclosure instead of asking every time.

picklists.$comment: Active values from the Asset object describe, verified 2026-08-04. The app re-reads these live when connected and falls back to this list offline.

orderStatus.$comment: Spec section 9 traps 1 and 2. 'Confirmed' and bare 'Shipped' do not exist in this org.

catalogFilters.$comment: Which serialized-catalog rows the Families & SKUs picker shows for each family, keyed on Product_Series__c — the org's "L3 Product Series". That field is the only one naming a product line exactly; Device_Type__c calls every Driveri model AND Octo "Driveri". Driveri is declared as every L1 Device except the D810 series rather than a list of its seven current series, so a new D-series model appears without a config edit while staying disjoint from Octo. HAPTIC is a real active series in the org with no serialized product carrying it — the rule is declared anyway, so the picker can say the org has none rather than that nobody configured it. Verified against testing 2026-08-15: driveri 135, octo 2, dhub 2, dms 2, vbus 3, haptic 0, of 169.
